headline: New MacBook Pro lineup reviewed, from modest update to pricey screen
summary: Apple's new MacBook Pro lineup drew mixed reviews: the M6 chip model is a modest but solid upgrade, while the pricier PROLED XDR/OLED touchscreen version impressed reviewers with its screen quality but drew criticism over cost, with outlets disagreeing on whether the touchscreen itself is worth the added price.

claims.statement: Apple's M6 MacBook Pro is a modest, incremental upgrade over the previous model.

sources.quote: A slight upgrade, but still the most accessible MacBook Pro
Apple’s brings its powerful M6 chip and N1 Wi-Fi 7 chip to the MacBook Pro.

claims.statement: The new MacBook Pro's PROLED XDR/OLED touchscreen display has excellent screen quality but comes at a much higher price.

sources.quote: The new OLED MacBook Pro comes with an incredible-looking touchscreen display—and an equally eye-popping price.
Apple's touchscreen laptop is a notable evolution of the MacBook Pro at a much higher price.
It has the best laptop screen we've used, but there may be reasons to wait.

discrepancies.explanation: Outlets differ on whether the new touchscreen itself is a worthwhile upgrade: one calls it the screen every Mac deserves, another says the touchscreen doesn't add much.

quotes.quote: The screen that every Mac deserves
